Name: Guniism's Unicycle
Author: Guniism
Description:
This mod adds an electric Unicycle to the game, for traveling around the Valley. The unicycle has moving animation.


[size=5]How to get the Unicycle
[/size]
The recipe can be bought from Blacksmith for 5000. Then you can craft it in your crafting menu by using:

[list][*]1 Battery Pack
[*]1 Iridium Bar
[*]5 Iron Bar
[*]10 Coal
[/list]

[size=5]Usage
[/size]
You can ride it by pressing Right-Click (Default).
When you ride it, it will display a +6 speed buff icon in the top right corner.
You can use the tool while riding. It is not allowed to be used inside the building.


[size=5]Config
[/size]
You can configure the ride button, speed, recipe price, and crafting recipe in config.json.
Or use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod to customize it.


[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list][*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6
[*]Works in single-player, co-op multiplayer.
[/list]


This is my first mod for Stardew Valley, I hope you like it.
If any errors occur, I apologize here. You can report it in the Bugs tab.
Also, if you have any suggestions, please leave a comment xD.
Here is the [url=https://github.com/Guniism/GuniismUnicycle]Source code[/url].
